- Pittsburgh Steelers (1980) – AFC North

ByAndrew Olson

* * *
Day 3 of the 2022 NFL Draft kicked off Saturday with Round 4, which consisted of picks 106-143. Nine more SEC players had their names called.

6.   No. 123 Isaiah Spiller, RB, Texas A&M (Los Angeles Chargers)  
7.   No. 124 Cade York, K, LSU (Cleveland Browns)  
8.   No. 126 Neil Farrell Jr., DT, LSU (Las Vegas Raiders)

The 1980s Super Bowl‑winning teams are:

- Pittsburgh Steelers (1980) – AFC North  
- Oakland/Los Angeles Raiders (1981 & 1984) – AFC West  
- San Francisco 49ers (1982, 1985, 1989) – NFC West

- Chicago Bears (1986) – NFC North  
- New York Giants (1987) – NFC East  

In the 2022 draft only **Pittsburgh Steelers** and **Los Angeles Raiders** selected SEC players:

* Pittsburgh Steelers drafted **DeMarvin Leal** (Texas A&M) and **Mark Robinson** (Ole Miss).  
* Los Angeles Raiders drafted **Isaiah Spiller** (Texas A&M).  

These are the only draft picks that fit the “1980s Super Bowl‑winning team” filter.  Consequently, the AFC North (Steelers) took **two** SEC players, while the AFC West (Raiders) took **one**.
